authority.template_reuse: ValidatorLedger, run_case_integration, run_case_export, run_stage, stratum_summaries, result_diagnostics, mu_diagnostic, orbit_mc source hash/contract binding, runtime tag decoding and Wilson estimators are imported from experiments.cft_orbit_wall_loss_v4.experiment; the field adapter is replaced by designs.py (L1a re-solve) because the sweep fields are not P2 FEM.

cases.reported_probability_case: accepted-2N (finest timestep); accepted-N is the convergence partner

claim_boundary.field_level: L1a linear constant-permeability axisymmetric equivalent-current FDM (cft_revival.fields); non-authoritative current bands, not a permanent-magnet material model, not P2 FEM, not hardware-valid
claim_boundary.orbit_model: collisionless prescribed-field relativistic-Boris test particles; no electric field, no collisions, no sheath, no self-consistent plasma
usable_as: design-dependent cusp/wall-loss input for the MDO labelled SCREENING_L1A_FIELD_TEST_PARTICLE_WALL_LOSS
a formal consumer of the orbit_mc coupling-v4.2 export format

classification_statement: Full-orbit collisionless test-particle electron wall-loss probabilities (orbit_mc v1.7) integrated in the accepted L1a linear-vacuum equivalent-current field maps of the geometry sweep v2. The fields are L1a screening fields (not P2-qualified), so every number in this campaign is SCREENING_L1A_FIELD_TEST_PARTICLE_WALL_LOSS: never accepted physical-orbit evidence, never a plasma or performance claim. The dataset is usable as surrogate training data and as a coupling/MDO input only when carried with this label.

consumer_checks: closed key set and constants of the handoff schema
successes = round(probability * trial_count) reproduces probability exactly
orbit_result_artifact_sha256 equals the sealed orbit artifact sidecar hash
coupling_consumer.v4_absence_statement: The v4 design (divergent-exit-stack, P2 FEM, NUMERICAL_P2_QUALIFIED) is not a sweep-v2 design and is therefore absent from the geometry screening set; the consumer formally consumes its coupling-v4.2 export as the accepted-evidence reference row, labelled as such, and consumes every screening design's handoff through the same verified path.

designs.extension_batch: the remaining 71 accepted designs, run in the same single execution
designs.extension_decision: Included at preregistration iff the shakedown's timing_projection.within_budget is true: the shakedown's measured mean per-orbit cost at N and 2N (under the concurrent host load) times three integrations per orbit (integration + write replay + verified-reload replay) over all 196 evidentiary cases, divided by the 12-worker pool, must not exceed 5400 s. The projection is recorded in shakedown.json and authorities.json; prepare and execute refuse if extension_batch_included disagrees with within_budget.
designs.fallback_rule: a design whose field cannot be rebuilt, re-solved or verified against the sealed sweep record is EXCLUDED before any orbit is integrated and listed with its reason in artifacts/design-exclusions.json; the campaign proceeds on the remaining designs (deterministic subset)

magnetic_moment_variation.statement: mu variation is reported per design (min/median/max, counts above 0.1 and 0.5) and never compared against a threshold that accepts or rejects anything; electrons in these cusp fields are non-adiabatic by construction.

diagnostics.reflection_counts: reported per design and per stratum (v4 found zero)
diagnostics.tolerance_close_share: fraction of orbits terminated through the typed tolerance-close fraction-zero path (physical wall/domain contact within event_tolerance_m); reported per design

execution.cpu_budget_note: at most 12 of the 24 logical CPUs (a concurrent MDO campaign shares the host); the GPU is not touched
execution.parallel_determinism_rule: every label access is recorded in case order before any orbit is integrated; field solves and cases then run in spawn process pools; each orbit is a pure function of (launch, field, config), every case is re-integrated twice by the deterministic replay validators (write + verified reload) and the first two launches of every case are re-integrated in the main process

field_source.bore_grid_rule: radial nodes 0..first node >= wall radius; axial nodes from the last node <= domain_z_min_m to the first node >= chamber length; every cell is homogeneous plasma (material id l1a-vacuum-bore-screening); PsiBicubicField built from psi with the solver's Br/Bz as reference maps (5 % consistency check) and the certificate tightness floor from gates
field_source.map_availability: Only the four representative designs (roles strongest-centreline, strongest-mirror, steepest-stage-gradient, lowest-field-energy/best-boundary-isolation) carry stored full-field maps in results/representatives; the other 92 designs are recorded as QoIs only. Every design is therefore re-solved.

refined_diagnostic.purpose: field-resolution diagnostic: the same problem re-solved at 160x288 intervals; compare_maps(accepted bore field, refined bore field) must stay within maximum_cross_resolution_b_relative_rms for every design, and the four representative designs additionally run a refined-N orbit case as a field-resolution sensitivity check of the wall-loss probability

resolve.identity_proof: rebuilt geometry_sha256, source_sha256, config_sha256 and case_sha256 must equal the sealed raw-results record; the re-solved QoIs must reproduce the recorded QoIs within the sweep's preregistered scale-aware replay tolerances; representatives must additionally reproduce the stored full-field nodes
resolve.source_binding: field_pipeline_source_sha256 over cft_revival/{fields,geometry,magnetics,optimization}/**/*.py, spec/fields/*.json and l1a_geometry_sweep_v2/{experiment.py,protocol.py,protocol.json,protocol.json.sha256} (LF bytes) is recorded in shakedown.json and authorities.json and re-verified by execute

gates.backend_parity_scope: cpu parity only (numpy vs Warp CPU); CUDA parity is not evaluated because the GPU is occupied and no CUDA path is used by this campaign
gates.convergence_rule: |P_wall(2N) - P_wall(N)| <= 0.02 (screening) AND adjacent Wilson intervals overlap; recorded as converged=true/false per design; not campaign-binding
gates.energy_gate_note: BINDING. Under orbit_mc >= 1.6 the event velocity is the Boris state at the event time, so in a prescribed pure-B field the relative kinetic-energy drift of every orbit is exactly 0.0.
gates.scope: evaluated PER DESIGN; the numerical/structural gates are binding for the dataset as a whole (a failure of any design rejects the execution), the probability-convergence gate is a per-design flag carried into the dataset
gates.timeout_policy: time_timeout and path_timeout are physical budget outcomes (survived two channel lengths of path); they are reported as the 'timeout' estimand per stratum and per design and flagged, not gated. v4 gated them because its P2 design had none; here the geometry varies.

launches.cell_rule: four axial cells at fixed fractions 1/8, 3/8, 5/8, 7/8 of the channel-straight span [chamber.injector_length_m, chamber.exit_start_m] (the region with wall-hit authority, excluding the injector zone); this scales v4's four-cell stratification to each design's own straight channel length. The sweep's axis |Bz| peak ('axis cusp') and axis null positions are recorded per design so each cell can be related to the field structure post hoc.
launches.gyrophase_offset_rule: 11*pi/96; disjoint (mod pi/4) from v1/v2 (0), v3 (pi/16), v4 (7*pi/48), the v4 shakedown (17*pi/96) and this campaign's shakedown (5*pi/96)
launches.radius_rule: two launch radii at 0.675 and 0.800 of the design's wall radius (as v4's 1.35 mm / 1.60 mm at 2 mm)
launches.seed_rule: orbit_mc build_launch_ensemble: seed = first 8 bytes of sha256(launch_id); launch_id is case-prefixed so every design/role/timestep has disjoint seeds

orbit_geometry_rule.divergent_exit_policy: wall-hit authority is restricted to the straight cylindrical dielectric section exactly as v4 did; an electron reaching r = wall radius at z > exit_start enters the divergent section and is classified domain_escape (post hoc sub-class divergent_section_radial); z = 0 is upstream_anode_plane escape; z = chamber length is exit_plane escape
orbit_geometry_rule.max_time_rule: max_time_s = max_time_transit_factor * max_path_m / v(slowest_energy_ev); i.e. twice the time a 5 eV electron needs for two channel lengths
orbit_geometry_rule.wall_z_max: chamber.exit_start_m (end of the straight dielectric; equals chamber.length_m when the design has no divergent exit)
orbit_geometry_rule.wall_z_min_meaning: anode plane (dielectric-straight region spans 0 <= z <= exit_start)

orbit_mc_contract.backend: numpy-cpu-relativistic-boris only; the Warp CUDA path is not used (RTX 5090 occupied by a PIC run; per-particle CUDA is 18x slower than numpy for this event loop)
orbit_mc_contract.source_hash_line_endings: LF (repo-wide .gitattributes eol=lf since fab0eccc); the hash is over the working-tree bytes and fails closed on any CR byte

prior_campaign_disclosure.relation: This campaign is NOT a successor of v4's evidence class: v4 is accepted physical-orbit evidence on a P2-qualified field; this is screening on L1a fields across many designs. Its launch design is disjoint from v1-v4 by position, energy/pitch/direction/gyrophase tuple, launch id and seed.
prior_campaign_disclosure.v1_v2_v3: failed on code (see v4 protocol prior_campaign_disclosure); gyrophase offsets 0, 0, pi/16

v4.headline: one P2-qualified design; wall-hit 0.641-0.645, escape 0.355-0.359, zero reflections, zero timeouts; cells 2-3 100 % wall loss, cell 4 (past wall end) 100 % escape, cell 1 direction-dependent

publication_policy.checkpoint_chain: built and validated per case in the working cache; the partial/batch/final checkpoint file hashes are recorded in the case summary; checkpoint bytes are not published
publication_policy.full_orbit_artifacts_published_for: representative_case_ids only (artifacts/orbits/<case_key>.json.gz), to bound the tracked bundle size; every other sealed artifact is identified by its sidecar hash and by the endpoints table
per_case: artifacts/summaries/<case_key>.json (summary, 32 strata with Wilson intervals, preflight, checkpoint-chain hashes, diagnostics, timing)
artifacts/endpoints/<case_key>.json.gz (one compact row per orbit: launch id, stratum, termination, escape sub-class, final r/z, steps, elapsed, energy error, mu variation, event resolution)
artifacts/orbits/<case_key>.json.sha256 (the sealed orbit artifact's sidecar; the artifact itself is replayed twice and hash-recorded)
per_design: artifacts/field-evidence/<case_id>.json (identity proof, QoI replay, stored-map agreement, interpolation and cross-resolution reports)

shakedown.design_rule: first, median and last of the sorted primary batch; the first is a representative so the refined-N path is exercised
shakedown.position_rng: numpy.random.default_rng(int.from_bytes(sha256(seed_namespace + ':' + case_id + ':positions')[:8], 'big')); per cell, per repeat: radius_fraction ~ U(range), axial_offset ~ U(-half_width, +half_width) * straight span
prepare_requires: passed == true (all validators passed for every shakedown case; export and consumer stages ran; bundle validated)
protocol_semantic_sha256 equals the current protocol hash
orbit_mc_source_sha256 equals the current orbit_mc source hash
field_pipeline_source_sha256 equals the current field pipeline source hash
disjointness proven against the evidentiary design of the same three designs and against v1/v2/v3/v4
shakedown.purpose: Exercise the complete production path (sweep binding, CPU re-solve, bore interpolant, preflight_campaign, integration, checkpoint chain, validators, estimators, gates, export construction, handoff consumer, dataset assembly, publication through the shared ExperimentRuntime into a temporary root, validate_bundle) on REAL re-solved fields for three designs before the preregistration freeze. v1/v2/v3 died on code the first time real data met the one-shot run; v4 and this campaign run the shakedown first.
